category: Belarusian file archive with a PayPal-only premium tier

free_tier.stated: 'загрузки и скачивания 100% Бесплатно для всех пользователей' with unlimited storage and unlimited retention; the free per-file cap is 100 MB, premium raises it to 1 GB.
free_tier.notes: Free accounts: 'хранятся файлы для неограниченный дней'.

per_object_cap.stated: 'Каждый файл вы загружаете должно быть меньше, чем 100 MB в размере для свободных / не счетов или меньше, чем 1 GB в размере для премиум-аккаунтов.'
per_object_cap.notes: The byte value treats the vendor's 1 GB premium cap as 1 GiB.

retention.stated: 'Free / не счета хранятся файлы для неограниченный дней. Премиум счета хранятся файлы для неограниченный дней.'

egress.terms: Premium removes the wait and the ads and allows 'Неограниченное количество одновременных загрузок' and 'Никаких ограничений на количество загрузок'. No byte quota published.

interface_detail: Web upload/download; premium advertises download-manager support ('Загрузка ... поддержка менеджера загрузок'). No API documented.
tooling: Browser; the premium checkout is a PayPal form posting to archive.by/paypal/pay.
chaining: A Belarusian place to park a public archive; it fetches from nowhere, so it is storage in the stack, not retrieval.

limits.value: 100 MB per file free, 1 GB per file premium
free tier: wait and ads, limited concurrent downloads; premium removes them

limits_note: Payment is a single gateway: each term's form posts to /paypal/pay and the only button is 'Pay with PayPal'.
binding_note: At 1 TiB a month on the premium tier, the 1 GB per-file ceiling is the first thing a large archive meets; storage and download count are unlimited, and there is no rate limit published.

identity_cost.detail: A premium purchase is completed through PayPal, so the identity is a PayPal account and the card behind it; no Russian or Belarusian local rail is offered on the page.

reliability_note: The interface is machine-translated Russian with visible artefacts ('100% Safe &Amp; Anonymous', 'премия Account'), which is a quality signal rather than a capacity one; a PayPal-only gateway means a buyer without PayPal cannot pay at all.
confidence_note: All five prices, both file caps, the unlimited-retention statement and the single PayPal gateway are quoted from live pages and raw HTML read.

evidence.proved: 7 days $4.99, 1 month $9.99, 3 months $19.99, 6 months $34.99, 1 year $59.99, 'Неограниченное хранение', 'Загрузка файлов до 1.00 GB'
100 MB free / 1 GB premium per-file cap, unlimited storage and unlimited retention on both tiers
the payment HTML: five forms posting to https://archive.by/paypal/pay with days=7/31/... and a single 'Pay with PayPal' image button - no card fields, no local gateway

price_per_tb_month: USD 9.99 per month at the 1-month term; USD 59.99 per year for unlimited storage
notes: The Belarusian equivalent asked for, and the inverse of bedrive: a BY service that takes only PayPal while a RU service takes only YooMoney. That pairing is the evidence that the payment wall follows the acquirer, not the language of the site. Whether a Belarusian buyer can actually complete a PayPal payment was not tested.
